summary: Frontend routing/entry-point verification for the three homepage entry cards. All five checks passed: (1) three entry cards visible with correct data-testids alongside stage-current/next/future and 'How a single Compass interaction unfolds' section and hero; (2) btn-teacher-experience navigates to ?review and TeacherReview renders ('One assignment, six students'); (3) btn-student-writing → ?preview=writing → welcome → assignment → Continue lands DIRECTLY on writing-input (organizing-thought NOT present); (4) btn-student-ot → ?preview=ot → welcome → assignment → Continue shows organizing-thought with 'The Assignment' stage active (writing-input NOT present); (5) default ?preview (no value) with clean localStorage lands on organizing-thought (default OT preserved).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx uses <a href="?preview=writing"> which causes a full page reload rather than SPA navigation — acceptable here since App.js reads query params on mount, but worth noting for future SPA router migration.
PublicPreview OT-resume via localStorage session can 'skip' the welcome screen if a prior session exists — expected behavior but testers should clear storage between manual retests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Entry-point routing verified end-to-end. Homepage now shows three EntryCards (btn-teacher-experience, btn-student-writing, btn-student-ot). ?preview=writing skips OT and goes straight to writing-input; ?preview=ot and default ?preview both show organizing-thought. TeacherReview renders on ?review. Full OT progression and engine were not re-tested per instructions (iteration_35 covers OT flow, iteration_34 covers Ch6).
